description: Advancement-based multiplier, randomised drops, and automatic reshuffling - the most complete advancement pack in the series.
body:
# The Complete Advancement Drop Randomizer, Shuffler & Multiplier

The most complete advancement pack in the series. Your multiplier doubles with every advancement earned, drops are fully randomised, and the pool reshuffles automatically on a timer. Two bossbars - one for your multiplier, one for the countdown.

## Features
- **1000+ blocks** all have randomized drops
- **Mob drops** are randomized too
- **Fishing** drops are randomized too
- **256 possible drop configurations** - reshuffled automatically on a timer
- **Every advancement doubles** your drop multiplier - permanently
- **Bossbar** showing your current drop multiplier at all times
- **Bossbar countdown** to the next reshuffle
- **Per-player tracking** - each player has their own multiplier
- Works in survival, no cheats required

## How to use
1. Install the datapack
2. Load your world
3. Start breaking things and earning advancements
4. Run `/function autoshuffle:set_1min`, `/function autoshuffle:set_5min` or `/function autoshuffle:set_10min` to set the interval
5. If adding to an existing world, run `/function adv_multiplier:recalculate` as each player to sync

## Notes
- Compatible with Minecraft 26.1.2
- Pure datapack - no mods, no executables

If you make a video using this datapack, a credit or link back to this page would be appreciated!
